newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore aerospace 1996 output up 10 percent -EDB.
newsitem.headline: Singapore aerospace 1996 output up 10 percent -EDB.

text.p: Singapore's aerospace industry is expected to register record output of Singapore $1.58 billion in 1996, up 10 percent from 1995, the Economic Development Board (EDB) said on Wednesday.
A spokesman also told reporters at an annual briefing on the sector that good growth was expected in 1997.
The strong performance in 1996 shows that Singapore's aerospace sector has successfully overcome the deep recession in the worldwide aerospace industry, the EDB said.
Singapore's industry managed an average annual compounded growth of 7.65 percent in output between 1993 and 1996 despite worldwide downsizing during that period.
Repair and overhaul operations made up about 87.5 percent of 1996 industry output, EDB said. Manufacturing operations accounted for the rest.
